title: Massive coverage gaps: 17 abilities, 4 archetypes, 14 enemy templates, 9 skills, 4 damage types, all pipeline steps untested
detail:
The coverage_summary reveals critical gaps across all dimensions:

**Untested abilities (17):** crit, deathMark, executionBonus, flatDamage, splash, stackDamage, buffPurge, attackSpeedAura, critAura, damageUpAura, rangeAura, soloBoost, curseZone, poisonZone, silenceZone, goldPassive, goldOnKill

**Untested enemy archetypes (4):** splitter, teleporter, buffer, dummy

**Untested attack styles (1):** aura_dot

**Untested enemy templates (14):** berserk, regen, healAura, speedAura, damageReduce, empBurst, siphonShield, blink, deathSplit, deathSlow, reflect, timewarp, revive, spawnMinions

**Untested skills (9):** chainLightning, nukeBomb, windBlade, channelLaser, missileBarrage, judgmentBeam, chainLightningBolts, judgmentRain, thunderSmite

**Untested damage types (4):** physical, magic, true, pure

**Untested pipeline steps (9):** ALL 9 steps of the damage pipeline are untested: immunity_check, boss_hp_cap, attacker_buff, target_debuff, damage_cap, shield_absorb, hp_deduct, threshold, death_check

**Untested buff stack modes (6):** ALL modes untested

**Untested events (7):** ALL random events untested

The current tests only cover map_01/normal with 2 strategies. No other maps or difficulties were tested.

suggested_fix.description: Expand test matrix: (1) Add scenario strategy that forces specific tower builds to trigger untested abilities, (2) Add skill_test strategy sessions, (3) Test all maps (map_02+), (4) Test hard/extreme difficulties, (5) Add enemy_filter for specific archetypes (splitter/teleporter/buffer), (6) Enable random events in test sessions. At minimum, 3 strategies x 4 maps x 4 difficulties = 48 sessions per round.
